topics.description: The Feeding Our Future fraud scheme, involving $250 million in COVID relief funds, continues to trend as a key figure was recently captured in Somalia.
topics.reason: The massive scale of the fraud and the international pursuit of suspects.

topics.topic: Minnesota Gov Walz and AG Ellison
topics.description: Minnesota Governor Walz and Attorney General Ellison faced criticism in a hearing over their handling of the $9 billion Somali fraud case.
topics.reason: The large amount involved and political scrutiny.
